description: Initial baseline: analyst_prompt_v1 + analysis_schema_v1 + screening_policy_v1; Claude Code CLI default model; tools disabled. Prompt written before any outcome for these offerings existed; no development cases.

Challenger: prompt v1.1 adds rule 12 (absences of evidence go to missing_information, not claims) after the TradeFunded baseline run failed validation on such a claim; plus one mechanical repair round that returns exact validation errors. TradeFunded is a development case (excluded from this version's evaluation).

v2.1 pipeline: stages A-F, per-criterion results, deterministic calculations, structured support check, computed four-dimension assessment, Korean summary after assessment. Rules derived while reviewing these three companies, so all three are development cases.
v2.2: per-rule decision chains for screening_policy_v1_2 (PROPOSED), evidence dimensions, generic-trigger guard, thesis questions, calculator v1_2. Hope-Neuron is a development case.
v2.2.1: authored rule predicates (policy v1_3, PROPOSED), predicate review in stage E, typed calculation requests, classifier v3_1. Hope-Neuron is a development case.
